title: The No. 1 Chair
meta_description: Week-1 AP No. 1 did not win the CFP in 2018-2025 (0 of 8) and did not finish final AP No. 1. Ohio State holds the 2026 chair. That is occupancy, not a forecast.
excerpt: From 2018 through 2025, 0 of 8 week-1 AP No. 1s won the CFP and 0 finished final AP No. 1. Five made the field and lost. Texas in 2025 finished 12th. Ohio State is the 2026 occupant only.
